report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show successful downstream calls and no errors, and metrics show zero 502s. Healthy telemetry contradicts any fault hypothesis, so no bounded root cause is established. Handing off rather than asserting a cause; the alert may reflect a benign latency level or a missing baseline.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Downstream service (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) latency metrics to localize any slow span
Error-rate or saturation metrics beyond the 60s window to detect a trend
